evals.name: removeviewbox-debug
evals.prompt: I ran svgo on my company logo and now it doesn't scale anymore when I resize the browser window. The original SVG used to fill its container fine. What happened and how do I fix it?
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses removeViewBox as the cause (it strips the viewBox attribute and breaks responsive scaling), and gives a concrete fix — either re-export the original SVG, or rerun SVGO with removeViewBox explicitly disabled (preset-default override).
assertions: Names removeViewBox specifically as the cause
Explains the response references that removing the viewBox attribute breaks responsive scaling
Mentions that removeViewBox is NOT in preset-default by default (so the user must have enabled it via flag or config)
Provides a concrete fix: either re-export the original SVG or rerun SVGO with removeViewBox disabled via a preset-default override
Includes a code snippet showing the preset-default `overrides: { removeViewBox: false }` config syntax

evals.name: cleanupids-collision
evals.prompt: I'm inlining about 20 icon SVGs directly into my HTML (each as a separate <svg> block). After running svgo on all of them, several icons are showing as broken or in the wrong color. The pre-svgo originals all rendered fine. Help me figure out what's happening.
evals.expected_output: Identifies the root cause as cleanupIds minifying IDs to short tokens (a, b, c) that collide when multiple optimized SVGs share an HTML document, breaking internal references (gradients, masks, clipPaths, <use>). Recommends prefixIds (with a per-file prefix), or disabling cleanupIds, or both.
assertions: Names cleanupIds specifically as the cause of the broken icons
Explains that cleanupIds minifies IDs to short tokens that collide when multiple SVGs are inlined in one HTML document
Recommends prefixIds as the primary fix (with per-file or filename-based prefix)
Mentions that disabling cleanupIds via preset-default override is also a valid mitigation
Includes a code snippet showing how to enable prefixIds and/or disable cleanupIds in svgo config

evals.name: node-build-script
evals.prompt: Write me a Node script that reads every SVG under src/icons/ and writes the optimized version to dist/icons/, preserving the same relative paths. I want viewBox kept (these icons need to stay responsive), I want prefixIds enabled with the icon's filename as the prefix so they're safe to inline together, and multipass on for max compression.
evals.expected_output: A working Node script that: imports optimize from 'svgo', recurses src/icons (or uses glob), creates dist/icons mirror dirs, calls optimize() with multipass: true, passes path to the optimize options, uses preset-default with overrides: { removeViewBox: false }, and enables prefixIds (filename-based prefix derived from the file's path).
assertions: Script imports optimize from the 'svgo' package
Script recursively walks src/icons (using fs/readdir recursive, glob, or fs.promises.readdir with recursion)
Script writes outputs to dist/icons preserving relative path structure
Script creates output directories (mkdir recursive) before writing files
Script sets multipass: true in the optimize() config
Script uses preset-default with overrides containing removeViewBox: false
Script enables prefixIds and uses the filename (or full path) as the prefix
Script passes the path option to optimize() so prefixIds can generate stable prefixes
